title: Talent Acquisition Consultant
description:
Talent Acquisition Consultant

Recruiter

Oldbury

Automotive

Hybrid

12 months Interim

Client Details

Michael Page are excited to partner with a nationwide leading organisation based in Oldbury to appoint for a 12 months interim Talent Acquisition Consultant role.

This role can offer hybrid working of 3 days office and 2 home per week.

This is a superb opportunity to join a growing team on a 12 months interim based with possible scope for a permanent position in future.

Description

Working as part of a busy team, the role of Talent Acquisition Consultant will involve taking responsibility for the full recruitment life-cycle of high-volume roles. You will play a vital role in the continuous growth and success of this division of the organisation

Duties will include but not limited to:
- Manage end-to-end recruitment activity for roles such as mechanics and field operatives, from vacancy briefing through to offer stage.
- Work with hiring managers to understand role needs and agree clear recruitment plans.
- Proactively source and engage suitable candidates through a wide range of recruitment channels.
- Review applications and coordinate interview processes to maintain a smooth and engaging candidate journey.
- Use data analysis to support with continuous improvement to the hiring process
- Support with a range of projects to further support candidate attraction and engagement

Profile

Ideal applicants for this role will demonstrate:
- Experience recruiting for high-volume roles within a similar sector
- Ability to work with hiring managers and build excellent stakeholder relationships within large, complex, multi-site organisations
- A proactive and innovative approach to candidate attraction and engagement

Job Offer
- 12 months fixed-term contract - with possible scope for permanent in future
- Up to 50,000pa
- Bonus
- Hybrid working - 3 days onsite and 2 home per week
- Exciting opportunity to play a vital part in the continued growth and success of an organisation
